methodology.headline: Estimated ranking. Reels are discovered natively on Instagram via Hashtag Search and Business Discovery, and supplemented with YouTube Shorts cross-posts where a view count is only available there. Rows are ranked on whichever metric Instagram actually publishes for them — views, or likes and comments — with each basis standardised against its own cohort.
methodology.not_claimed: This is not Meta's internal ranking and does not reproduce it. No Instagram scraping is performed, and no view count is ever estimated from likes.

reach.headline: No stored history to compare against, so these results cannot be placed on a scale. 10 of 10 clear a basic floor of 5,000.
